engine.notes: Arlington proper has no improv theater: the Arlington Improv at the Highlands is a stand-up chain club with no improv classes, and Theatre Arlington's acting classes use improvisation as a tool rather than teaching it. entries.name: ZingerZ Comedy Club at ONSTAGE in Bedford
entries.summary: DFW's family-friendly clean improv show, resident at the Old Bedford School theater ten miles north of Arlington, playing select Saturday nights with improv classes and a summer improv camp for ages 11 to 18.
entries.schedule: Clean Improv Comedy Show select Saturdays 7:30pm (e.g. Jan 10 2026); summer improv camp ages 11-18, $250
entries.reasons: A decade-old troupe with a permanent stage and classes, but shows are select Saturdays and the venue page prints no dated calendar of its own.
